doc_title: CONSENT TO RECTIFY THE REGISTER BY INDIVIDUAL
doc_title_official: CONSENT TO RECTIFY THE REGISTER BY INDIVIDUAL
when_used: An individual affected by an intended rectification of the register consents to it, so that the Registrar may rectify.

body_text.text: The above named being the affected party/parties hereby acknowledge and declare that :-
I/We have full knowledge of the intended rectification;
I/We understand the nature and effect of this Consent;
AND I/We HEREBY CONSENT to the rectification of the register.

execution.verification_heading: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act

custom_fields.name: nature_of_rectification
custom_fields.label: Nature of the rectification consented to
custom_fields.prompt: What is to be rectified in the register, set out as the entry to be corrected and the correction sought
